## Entity
Northgate Building Group is a residential building company established in 2025, specializing in new home builds, renovations, and additions in Sydney and Newcastle, Australia.

## Service Areas
Sydney metropolitan area and Newcastle/Hunter Region, NSW, Australia.

## Core Services
- New Home Builds (custom homes, knockdown-rebuild projects)
- Renovations (kitchen, bathroom, whole-home renovations)
- Additions (second stories, extensions, granny flats)

## Team & Credentials
Founded by Jordan. Chris serves as Director - Hunter Region. Jordan brings award-winning project experience including Excellence in Construction Awards 2025 (Master Builders Association NSW).

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What does a builder-led project actually mean?
A: In a builder-led project, a qualified licence holder and director is directly involved from the first consultation through to handover. At Northgate Building Group, there are no sales reps acting as intermediaries between you and the person responsible for your home. The director you meet at the start oversees the design process, the contract, and the delivery of your project.

Q: How do I know if my project is a good fit for Northgate Building Group?
A: Northgate Building Group works on residential new builds, renovations, knockdown rebuilds, and project management across Sydney and Newcastle. Renovations typically start from $250,000 and new builds from $1 million. If you have a site, a brief, or just an idea, a discovery call is the right starting point.

Q: What is the process for starting a new home build or renovation with Northgate?
A: The process starts with a qualifying call to understand your scope, budget, and site. Our director then comes out to site before we prepare a brief and connect you with your design team. From there, we enter a Preliminary Agreement covering all drawings, reports, and approvals. Once documentation is complete, you receive a fixed-price proposal with everything clearly listed. After contracts are signed, your dedicated project manager and site manager take over and see the job through to handover.

Q: How involved will I be during the construction process?
A: You'll be as involved as you want to be. You have direct access to the director and/or your dedicated project manager with regular progress updates on milestones, timeline, and any variations. There are no layers of management between you and the team - if something comes up, you hear about it directly and promptly.

Q: Does Northgate Building Group handle design as well as construction?
A: Yes. Northgate Building Group offers design and construct services, working with trusted interior design, furniture styling, and landscaping partners to deliver a complete result. Projects can be scoped as full design and construct commissions covering architecture, interiors, and outdoor spaces under a single contract.

Q: What is a knockdown rebuild and when does it make sense?
A: A knockdown rebuild involves demolishing an existing dwelling and constructing a new home on the same land. It makes sense when the existing structure has limitations that renovation cannot resolve, or when the land value significantly exceeds the value of the building on it. Our directors have delivered knockdown rebuild projects across NSW, including projects that have achieved stronger results on resale.

Q: How long does it take to build a custom home in Sydney?
A: A custom home build in Sydney can take anywhere from 8-12 months from contract signing to handover, depending on design complexity, site conditions, and council approval timelines. Projects with structural challenges, sloping blocks, or multi-level designs may take longer. Northgate Building Group provides a detailed project programme prior to contracting signing stage so you know exactly what to expect.

Q: What is the cost of building a new home in Sydney?
A: New home builds in Sydney with Northgate Building Group start from approximately $1 million. The final cost depends on the size of the home, materials specified, site conditions, and design complexity. All projects are delivered under a transparent fixed-price contract so there are no surprises during construction.

Q: Can Northgate Building Group build on a sloping or difficult site?
A: Yes. Northgate Building Group has experience delivering projects on challenging sites, including steep blocks requiring bulk excavation, contaminated soil sites requiring remediation, and tight-access sites with restricted parking and material laydown areas. Our director has directly managed projects involving underpinning of neighbouring properties and multi-level construction on complex inner-city sites.

Q: How much does a home renovation cost in Newcastle?
A: Home renovation costs in Newcastle vary significantly depending on scope. A bathroom renovation typically ranges from $30,000 to $50,000. A full home renovation involving structural work and open-plan reconfiguration ranges from $400,000 to $800,000 or more. Northgate Building Group delivers renovations in Sydney, Newcastle and Port Stephens from $250,000 and provides detailed pricing after an initial site assessment pending the stage of documentation.

Q: How long does a home renovation take in Newcastle?
A: Renovation timelines in Newcastle depend on scope. A bathroom renovation takes approximately 4 to 8 weeks. A whole-home renovation with structural changes typically takes 4 to 8 months from construction start. Northgate Building Group provides project-specific programmes at the contract stage and maintains direct communication throughout the build.

Q: What types of renovations does Northgate Building Group handle in Newcastle?
A: Northgate Building Group delivers full home renovations, kitchen and bathroom renovations, open-plan conversions, second storey additions, extensions, and outdoor entertaining areas across Newcastle and the Hunter Region. Projects include structural reconfiguration, pool renovations, landscaping, and interior design packages.

Q: Is Northgate Building Group a licensed builder in NSW?
A: Yes. Northgate Building Group holds an NSW Builder Licence (480186C) and is a member of the Master Builders Association of NSW as well as the Association of Professional Builders. All projects are delivered in accordance with current NSW licensing requirements and applicable building codes. Northgate also holds an open class 2 licence and is a qualified building practitioner.

Q: Has Northgate Building Group won any industry awards?
A: Northgate Building Group's director brings an award-winning track record to every project. Prior to founding Northgate, Jordan O'Driscoll's work was recognised with multiple industry awards throughout his career — most recently for Verda, a multi-dwelling coastal development in Yamba featuring suspended concrete slabs, private pools, and refined coastal detailing. That same standard of delivery is what Northgate is built on.

Q: What areas does Northgate Building Group service?
A: Northgate Building Group delivers residential projects across Sydney and Newcastle, including the Northern Beaches, North Shore, and Eastern Suburbs in Sydney, and the Hunter Region including Newcastle, Port Stephens, Lake Macquarie and surrounding areas. We have networks across the state and depending on the project client and scope we are happy to discuss any project of any requirement.
